Name: Luoli Hair Collection  1.6 available
Author: luoli1119
Description:
我所有头发mod的一个合集，后续有更新的头发这里也会同步更新。
对部分发型的侧面进行了修改，适用于1.5与1.6的电脑端，手机端无法使用FS可以将贴图单独拿出进行合并，手机无法使用FS不是bug。
如果想要下载单独的头发请在我的主页进行下载，mod都是免费分享的，请勿二传以及倒卖，如果要对mod贴图进行二次更改或分发请联系我，请不要私自进行更改或分发。


A collection of all my hair mods. If there are any new hairs, they will be updated here.The sides of some hairstyles have been modified. It is suitable for 1.5 and 1.6 PC versions. If the mobile version cannot use FS, you can take out the textures separately and merge them. It is not a bug that the mobile version cannot use FS.If you want to download a single hair, please download it from my homepage. All mods are shared for free. Please do not repost or resell them. If you want to make secondary changes or distribute the mod textures, please contact me. Please do not make changes or distribute them privately.
